_README: Controlled semantic-mismatch probe. Each item has a query, a GOLD passage (semantically correct, often low lexical overlap with the query), a TRAP passage (high lexical overlap but wrong meaning — a BM25 attractor), and DISTRACTORS. All gold+trap+distractor passages from every item are pooled into one corpus; for each query we measure whether retrieval ranks the gold passage above the trap and the rest. Categories: paraphrase, legal_synonymy, reformulation, low_overlap, control (control = high lexical overlap, BM25-friendly).
